purpose: Teach: 立たさ/公布/蜂起/死傷/迎撃/内包/輩出/わいせつ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、窮地に立たされた時こそ団結しろ
lines.en: When our company faces crisis, that's when we must stand together.
lines.style: Measured, commanding opening. Clear enunciation on key words. Steady pace, no rush. The voice of someone used to being heard. Quiet authority—not loud, but impossible to ignore.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新ガイドライン公布を社員に周知します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure all staff are informed about the new guidelines.
lines.style: Attentive, efficient. Slight forward lean in the phrasing. Professional warmth—responding with competence, not just compliance. Respectful but not obsequious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の蜂起を生まぬよう対話を重ねろ
lines.en: And keep dialogue open with the team—prevent any sense of unrest before it starts.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Each instruction lands clearly. Pauses between clauses like laying down careful steps. The tone of someone who has seen what miscommunication costs.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。労災での死傷者を最少に抑えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll ensure we keep workplace incidents and injuries to the absolute minimum.
lines.style: Clipped, professional. Each phrase precise. Shows he's tracking the priorities: safety first, then operations. Quiet conviction—not defensive, just committed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合の動きを迎撃する体制を作れ
lines.en: Build the structure to match our competitors' moves—stay ahead of them.
lines.style: Sharper tempo. Slight emphasis on 'structure' and 'ahead.' Tactical, not emotional. The voice of strategy. Clean attack on the opening word.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品に内包される技術特許を確認しました
lines.en: Yes. I've verified the proprietary technology and patents embedded in the new product line.
lines.style: Precise, methodical. The pride of someone who has done thorough work. Speaks with the clarity of someone reporting facts they've personally checked. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界のトップ人材を輩出する会社になれ
lines.en: Our company will become known as a developer of top talent in this industry.
lines.style: Vision-forward. Opens with quiet intensity. Slower pace—this isn't a directive, it's an aspiration. Slight lift at the end, like inviting them into the goal.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員のわいせつ行為は厳罰で対応します
lines.en: Understood. Any breach of conduct will be met with strict consequences.
lines.style: Closing statement—slightly more weight. Matter-of-fact, no room for interpretation. Professional distance returns. Ends on a note of finality, like closing a file.
